2117220957622255727.en_summary: @aleabitoreddit says October hedge fund de-grossing was the highest in 10 years per Morgan Stanley, with Goldman seeing about $20B of selling in 2 weeks, while short interest rose sharply in names such as $AAOI (12.5% to 19.84%+), $AEVA, $CBRS, $CRWV and others. Author still calls AI capex in photonics and memory a generational opportunity, citing $AXTI Q4 annualized at 23.7x P/E, $SKHY about $59B operating profit versus $AMZN $28.1B, and no material $MSFT/$AMZN capex cuts plus $SPCX securing $40B more for GPUs. A chart image is attached.
2117220957622255727.zh_summary: @aleabitoreddit 引述摩根士丹利數據指十月對沖基金去槓桿為十年最高，高盛兩週約見200億美元賣盤，並指$AAOI、$AEVA、$CBRS、$CRWV等淡倉比例急升（如$AAOI由12.5%升至19.84%以上）。作者仍視光子與記憶體相關AI資本開支為世代級機會，舉例$AXTI第四季年化本益比約23.7倍、$SKHY營業利益約590億美元高於$AMZN的281億，且$MSFT/$AMZN未明顯砍資本開支、$SPCX再獲400億美元GPU採購。附圖。
